Priority.Name: Art priority
Priority.Label: Give this module priority
Priority.Hint: Puts this module first among compendium art providers (ahead of Daggerheart Core Rulebook, for example). You can adjust the order at any time in Core settings, "Compendium Art" menu.

Replace.Name: Already imported adversaries
Replace.Label: Apply art
Replace.Hint: Replaces the portraits and tokens of adversaries already in the world (and their tokens placed on scenes) with this module's art. Compendium art is only applied at import time.

Priority.Title: {module} — Art priority
Priority.Body: The {module} module provides art for Daggerheart adversaries, but these modules currently take precedence over it:
Priority.Question: Give priority to {module}?
Priority.Hint: This module will be placed first for the adversaries it covers; other adversaries keep the art from other modules. A world reload is required.
Priority.AlreadyTop: This module already has compendium art priority.
Priority.Done: This module now has compendium art priority.

Replace.Title: Apply art to world adversaries
Replace.Summary: {actors} world adversary(ies) and {tokens} token(s) placed on {scenes} scene(s) don't use this module's art yet.
Replace.Hint: Only adversaries imported from the Daggerheart compendium and covered by this module are changed.
Replace.Done: Art applied: {actors} actor(s), {tokens} token(s) on scenes.
Replace.NothingToDo: Nothing to do: the {count} world adversary(ies) covered by this module already use its art.
Replace.LoadError: Could not load the module's mapping file (see console).
Replace.GMOnly: Only a GM can apply art.
